names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 7 iulie, «Sfântul Cuvios Acachie», with the rank words left off.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

feast.note: doxologia.ro keeps him on a second Romanian day: its calendar for 29 noiembrie prints «Sfântul Cuvios Acachie» and serves under it the same life out of the fourth step of John of the Ladder. The corpus keeps one feast to a church, so 7 iulie, the day he was first read on, stands as the feast, and 29 noiembrie is noted here.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 7 iulie — «Sfântul Cuvios Acachie»
